data.comment:
# Comfy Kling O3- FLF2V

Upload reference images or specify start and end frames. Generate a video with precise semantic control, longer duration, and improved narrative coherence. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_kling_o3_flf2v.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.prompt: A graceful pale-haired girl in an ivory lace outfit and orange-tinted sunglasses rides a majestic white horse. The scene transitions from a calm, intimate close-up (first frame) to a dynamic, sweeping gallop across a sun-drenched desert (end frame). The horse’s mane flows with motion, and the desert landscape shifts from a soft, ethereal close-up to a vast, open expanse. The transition is smooth, maintaining the character’s and horse’s consistent appearance and style, with cinematic lighting and a dreamlike, otherworldly atmosphere.
